notes:
May 24th 2026
Version 10.1+ (stable) / 10.2+(beta)
**********************
NEW! RELEASE BETA
* Korg side now has the same inline filter bar as Roland — Ctrl+F filters scenes live (K)
* Korg Backup button now actually lights up on hover (used to be a no-op) (K)
* Ctrl+F now opens an inline filter bar — type a name and the tree collapses to only the banks and UPGs that match (R)
* Quick Help popup restyled — resizable, scrollable, and covers every right-click feature including the new Hand Copy/Paste (R K)
* Right-click Copy menu now shows the source name so you know exactly what you're about to copy (R K)
* Support tickets now auto-include your last 3 Live UPG Editor files (R)
* Fixed FR-8x expansion slots showing "Unknown" for the newer Roland 8x Special packs (Piano&Kbd, Gtr&Brs, Strings, Pad&Oth, Accord)
* Support tickets now accept video clips (.mp4/.mov/.webm) up to 10 MB each (R K)
* FR-4x print/CSV/HTML drum kit names corrected (no more FR-8x labels) (R)
notes_beta:
May 24th 2026
Version 10.1+ (stable) / 10.2+(beta)
**********************
NEW! RELEASE BETA
* Korg backup tree no longer slowly scrolls on its own — fixed a latent bug where simply hovering the cursor near the tree edge would activate the drag-only edge auto-scroll (K)
* Bass editor (FR-8X only): added Voicing control (Accordion / Mode 1 / Mode 2) — matches Roland's own Bass editor, lets you change the bass voicing engine per register (R)
* Live Editor: changing an orchestra tone (Orch 1/2, Orch Chord, Orch Free Bass) now re-syncs the editor with the accordion's auto-applied MFX defaults so the next Send doesn't revert them (R)
* Fixed "Settings differ from connected accordion" popup that wrongly showed Unknown (CC32=10) for the 8xSp_Accord expansion pack — cached data from older builds is now auto-repaired on launch (R)
* Organ editor Mix tab: removed Octave and Pan controls that produced no audible change and were silently clobbering Orchestra 1 state when used (R)
* Drum editor: renamed "Treble Mode" combo to "Drum Mode" to match its actual function (Solo / Layer for drum coexistence with right-hand sections) (R)
* Right Hand Mode editor: removed hidden duplicate Drum Shift / Mode controls — those belong to the Drum section per Roland's manual and live there now (R)
* Fixed panel light and section syncing.
* Korg side now has the same inline filter bar as Roland — Ctrl+F filters scenes live (K)
* Korg Backup button now actually lights up on hover (used to be a no-op) (K)
* Ctrl+F now opens an inline filter bar — type a name and the tree collapses to only the banks and UPGs that match (R)
* Quick Help popup restyled — resizable, scrollable, and covers every right-click feature including the new Hand Copy/Paste (R K)
* Right-click Copy menu now shows the source name so you know exactly what you're about to copy (R K)
* Support tickets now auto-include your last 3 Live UPG Editor files (R)
* Fixed FR-8x expansion slots showing "Unknown" for the newer Roland 8x Special packs (Piano&Kbd, Gtr&Brs, Strings, Pad&Oth, Accord)
* Support tickets now accept video clips (.mp4/.mov/.webm) up to 10 MB each (R K)
* FR-4x print/CSV/HTML drum kit names corrected (no more FR-8x labels) (R)
